## Download

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `YTDownloadManager-Setup-x64.exe` | Windows, 64-bit (most PCs) |
| `YTDownloadManager-Setup-x86.exe` | Windows, 32-bit |
| `YTStandaloneDownloader-Extension.zip` | The browser extension alone (Linux, macOS, or without the app) |
| `yt-standalone-downloader.user.js` | The userscript, for Tampermonkey |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums of all files above |

How to install: see the [README](https://github.com/NyxiYT/yt-download-manager#installation).
With [Scoop](https://scoop.sh): `scoop bucket add nyxiyt https://github.com/NyxiYT/yt-download-manager`, then
`scoop install nyxiyt/yt-download-manager`.

Already installed? Version 1.9.0 and newer update themselves: click the notification, or **Update** in the app.
Coming from 1.8.0 or older, open this release's installer and click **Update**, then click the reload icon on the
extension's card in `chrome://extensions` once and refresh your YouTube tabs.

Like the app? You can [support the project](https://github.com/NyxiYT/yt-download-manager#support-the-project).
